name: mdrv_delete_file
description: Permanently delete a file by `id` (UUID) — removes both the database record and the object in Spaces. Irreversible; prefer mdrv_update_file with trashed=true (move to Trash) unless the user explicitly wants a permanent delete. Confirm the exact file (name) with the user first. Requires the write scope. Returns 204 No Content on success.
